newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia BTC raises equity capital.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia BTC raises equity capital.

text.p: Slovenian warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC on Monday raised its equity capital by 1.83 billion tolars ($11.7 million) to 6.64 billion, the Ljubljana bourse said.
"This increase is connected to our GDR issue and our bourse needs to approve the equity extension before shares are traded abroad," Helena Petrin, the company's general secretary, told Reuters.

The company issued another 229,267 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 8,000 tolars each, extending the number of its shares to 830,000. BTC completed its global depository receipts (GDRs) issue at the beginning of June.

BTC said earlier it needed the capital increase in order to finance the expansion of its shopping, sport and business centre areas in Ljubljana by about 40 percent within the next couple of years. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
